text: The proof of the theorem `lg_target` relies on the lemma `Real.log_rpow`, which states that for any positive real number `x` and any real exponent `y`, `Real.log (x ^ y) = y * Real.log x`. In this case, we have `y = 3`, so applying this lemma directly with `hx : 0 < x` gives the desired result: `Real.log (x ^ 3) = 3 * Real.log x`. No additional conditions or cases are needed since the lemma holds for all positive `x`.
